ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white/grey) localized patches on the inner lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous off-white/light-grey region on the upper visible lobe containing dark vertical striations; fine linear white streaks on the dark central ventral fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute-angled V-shaped depression visible at the convergence of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the upper lobe; high-amplitude, irregular jagged notches and peaks along the foreground fluke edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer edge of the upper lobe; predominantly linear trajectory for the foreground fluke lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white spots (barnacles) distributed along trailing edges and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel, vertical light-colored linear disruptions (rake marks) on the dark lower portion of the upper fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive brownish-white textured barnacle colonization visible on the leading edge of the foreground fluke and the central trailing edge area.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct saw-tooth profile on the foreground fluke lobe's trailing edge relative to the smoother topography of the upper lobe.
